verses.en: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
verses.sm: Aua o le tulafono ua i ai le ata o mea lelei atali, a ele o le matuá tusa o ia mea, e le mafaia lava i ia taulaga o loo avatua soo lava i lea tausaga ma lea tausaga ona faaatoatoaina o e faalatalata i ai.

verses.en: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
verses.sm: Ana mafaia po ua tuua ia taulaga, auá ana uma ona faamamáina O e na auauna ai, po ua le toe iloa agasala i le loto fuatia ifo;

verses.en: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
verses.sm: a o ia taulaga na faamanatu ai agasala i lea tausaga ma lea tausaga;

verses.en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
verses.sm: aua e le mafai ona aveeseina o agasala i le toto o povi poa ma “on.

verses.en: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua fetalai mai ai o ia i lona maliu mai i le lalolagi, O manu fasia atoa ma taulaga ua e le finagalo î ai, a ua saunia e oe le tino mo au;

verses.en: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
verses.sm: o taulaga mu ma taulaga mo agasala ua e le fiafia i ai;

verses.en: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
verses.sm: ona ou fai ane lea, Le Atua e, silasila mai ia, ou te alu atu e faia lcu finagalo, pei ona tusia ia te au i le tusi taai.

verses.en: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
verses.sm: Ua muamua ona fetalai mai, O manu fasia, o taulaga foi, ma taulaga mu, ma taulaga mo agasala ua e le finagalo i ai, ma e le fiafia i ai—o mea ia ua faia e tusa ma le tulafono—9 ona toe fetalai mai lea,

verses.en: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
verses.sm: Le Atua e, silasila mai ia, ou te alu atu e faia lou finagalo. Ua aveeseina ai e ia le mea na muamua, ina ia faatumauina o lona lua.

verses.en: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
verses.sm: O le finagalo lea ua faapaiaina ai i tatou i le taulaga i le tino o Iesu Keriso na fai faatasi.

verses.en: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
verses.sm: Ua tutu foi ositaulaga uma ua auauna i lea aso ma lea aso, o loo avatu soo ia lava taulaga e le mafaia lava ona aveeseina ai o agasala.

verses.en: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
verses.sm: Peitai ane o ia, na avatua e ia le taulaga e tasi mo agasala, ona nofo lea o ia i le itu taumatau o le Atua e faavavau,

verses.en: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
verses.sm: 0 loo faatalitali atu ai pea, seia avea i latcu o e fai o ia mo latou fili ma mea e tu ai ona aao.

verses.en: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
verses.sm: Aua o le taulaga e tasi ua faaatoatoaina ai e ia e faavavau o e ua faapaiaina.

verses.en: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
verses.sm: O loo molimau mai ai foi je Agaga Paia ia i tatou; aua ua uma ona muai fetalai mai o ia,

verses.en: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
verses.sm: O le feagaiga lava lenei ou te faia mai latou pe a mavae atu 1a.aso, o loo fetalai mai ai le Alii, ou te tuuina atu au tulafono i o latou loto, ma ou tusi ai i o latou mafaufau, ona ia toe fetalai mai ai lea,

verses.en: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.sm: O a latou agasala foi ma o latou solitulafono ou te le toe manatua lava.

verses.en: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
verses.sm: O lenei, o le mea o i ai le faamagaloina o ia mea, ua leai se toe taulaga mo le agasala.

verses.en: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
verses.sm: O lenei, le au uso e, ua tatou sa'oloto e ulu atu i le mea e sili ona paia ona o le toto o Iesu,

verses.en: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
verses.sm: i le ala fou e ola ai, ua faaavanoaina e ia mo i tatou i le ie puipui, o lona lava tino lea,

verses.en: And having an high priest over the house of God;
verses.sm: mona ua ia i tatou le ositaulaga sili e pule i le fale o le Atua,

verses.en: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.sm: ina tatou faalatalata atu ia ma le loto faamaoni i le faatuatua ua mautinoa lava, o sausauina o tatou loto nai le manatu ifo ua leaga, o taelea foi o tatou tino i le vai manino.

verses.en: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
verses.sm: Ina tatou taofi mau ia i le faamoemoe ua tatou ta‘utino atu ma le le fefoifoiai; aua e faamaoni o ia ua folafola mai;

verses.en: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
verses.sm: ia tatou manatunatu foi le tasi i le tasi, ina ia taufaatupu ai le alofa ma galuega lelei;

verses.en: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
verses.sm: aua le lafoaiina le faapotopotoina o i tatou, pei o le masani o isi, a ia fefaamafanafanai; ia atili ai foi ona faapea ina ua outou iloa o le Aso o loo táulata mai.

verses.en: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
verses.sm: Aua afai tatou te agasala ma le loto i ai pe a uma ona talia o le malamalama o le upu moni, ua le toe lava se taulaga mo agasala,

verses.en: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
verses.sm: na o le faatali ma le mata'u tele i le faamasinoga ma le toasa e mumù e susunu ai i e o tetee atu.

verses.en: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
verses.sm: O le na faaleaogaina le tulafono a Mose na oti o ia i le mau a le toalua po o le toatolu, ua le alofagia.

verses.en: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
verses.sm: Pe ni a fa outou i le sili o le mamafa o le taui e ta‘utatauina ai lé ua soli le Alo o le Atua, ma ua ta‘ulepaiaina e ia le toto o le feagaiga na faapaiaina ai o ia, ma ua upu leaga i le Agaga o le alofa tunoa?

verses.en: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
verses.sm: Aua ua tatou iloa le na fetalaia mai, O ia ta au le taui ma sui, ou te taui atu. le ma lea, E faamasino e le Alii lona lava nuu.

verses.en: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.sm: O le mea e mata'u tele ai ona maua e aao o le Atua soifua.

verses.en: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
verses.sm: A ia outou manatu i aso anamua, ina o faamalamalamaina outou, na outou onosai ai i le tana tele o tiga;

verses.en: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
verses.sm: ina ua faia outou ma mataaga i npu faifai ma puapuaga, tasi lea mea; i le ma lenei, ina ua faatasia outou ma e na faapeaina.

verses.en: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
verses.sm: Aua na outou alolofa mai i e ua noanoatia, ma outou onosai i le vetega o a outou oloa ma le olioli, ina ua iloa e outou ua ia te outou le oloa e sili ona lelei ma le tumau.

verses.en: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
verses.sm: O le mea lea aua le lafoai ai lo outou loto tele, ana ua i ai le taui e tele.

verses.en: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
verses.sm: Aua ua aoga ia te outou le onosai, ina ia maua e outou le mea na folafolaina, pe a uma ona faia e outou le finagalo o le Atua.

verses.en: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
verses.sm: Aud e toe itiiti itiiti lava, ona oo mai ai lea o le maliu mai, e le faatuai mai lava.

verses.en: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
verses.sm: A e ola le amiotonu i le faatuatua; i le ma lea, A tuumuli, e le fiafia lava lo'u loto ia te ia.

verses.en: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
verses.sm: A o i tatou e le o nie tuumuli i le malaia, a o ni e faatuatua e ola ai le agaga.
